question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 K 组：哥伦比亚 vs 刚果民主共和国（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K: Colombia vs DR Congo (three-way result after 90 minutes)
one_liner_cn: Elo 差 330 分、状态火热且阵容齐整的哥伦比亚是明确强方，世界杯首秀的刚果（金）爆冷需要超常发挥。
one_liner_en: With a 330-point Elo gap, hot form and a fully fit squad, Colombia are the clear stronger side; an upset by debutants DR Congo would require an exceptional performance.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 330 分（哥伦比亚 1982 第 7 vs 刚果（金）1652 第 55），统计基准强烈倾向哥伦比亚。
key_reasons.en: A 330-point Elo gap (Colombia 1982, rank 7 vs DR Congo 1652, rank 55) makes the statistical baseline strongly favour Colombia.

key_reasons.cn: 哥伦比亚 26 人名单核心齐整、无伤病减员，曾 28 场不败并打进 2024 美洲杯决赛。
key_reasons.en: Colombia's 26-man squad is at full strength with no injury absences, after a 28-match unbeaten run and the 2024 Copa America final.

key_reasons.cn: 刚果（金）1974 年后首次参赛、全队均为世界杯首秀，主力前锋 Wissa 上赛季伤病缠身状态起伏。
key_reasons.en: DR Congo are at their first finals since 1974 with an all-debutant squad, and lead striker Wissa is coming off an injury-hit, inconsistent season.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 0.704/0.191/0.105; a bounded +2pp/-1pp/-1pp evidence adjustment (full-strength Colombia vs all-debutant DR Congo with striker form concerns) yields 0.72/0.18/0.10. No betting or prediction-market data used.
